relations: A stationary camera keeps the horizon, clouds, and glow fixed while waves propagate toward the viewer.
Swell crests and whitecaps drift steadily toward the lower-left, sliding closer to the bottom edge.
The foreground foam line advances downward, churning and reshaping continuously above the darker shallow-water edge.
Mid-distance dark swells rise and fall slightly in amplitude within the moving wave pattern.
caption: The video captures an open-ocean seascape beneath an overcast sky, where a soft bright glow lingers near the fixed horizon. The sea fills the lower half of the frame with several swell lines and small whitecaps, while a band of white breaking foam crosses the foreground above a darker shallow-water edge. Swell crests and the small whitecaps drift steadily toward the lower-left, consistent with waves propagating toward the viewer. A central whitecap and a leftmost whitecap each slide gradually closer to the bottom edge. The foreground foam line advances downward, its texture churning and reshaping continuously. Mid-distance dark swells rise and fall slightly in amplitude within the moving wave pattern. The horizon, cloud formation, and the glow near the horizon remain at essentially fixed screen positions throughout, indicating a stationary camera.
